Give it a go you will not be dissappointed
Mar 2026 • Couples
What a gem. Hidden away outside of the main tourist area in district 1. A quiet place with a nice decor. The waitress was attentive without being imposing. We shared a pesto bruchetta that had lots of flavour. There were 5 pieces. Unless you are really hungry its a 2 person starter. My wife had tagliatelli with salmon which she said was lovely with lots of fish. I had a medium pizza which was the best I have had in Nam. A lovely all round experience to end our holiday.
